jobs.title: Operations Manager, Influencer Marketing
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.



At Roblox, we're building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We're on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.



A career at Roblox means you'll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.


We're looking for a Manager of Influencer Marketing to build and scale the operational backbone of our global influencer program. This is not a traditional campaign role — you'll be the person who turns creator relationships and regional programs into a repeatable, data\-driven machine. You'll own the systems, playbooks, and tools that allow our influencer marketing team to operate efficiently at scale across markets and content types.



This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program operations, and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, loves building things from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of bringing structure to a fast\-moving space.


**You will:**
-------------


**Program Operations \& Scale**


* Design and manage the operational infrastructure for a global influencer program spanning multiple content types, markets, and campaign types
* Partner with web systems team to manage front\-end, creator facing authenticated portal as well as back\-end systems
* Build scalable workflows in our CRM system for influencer sourcing, contracting, onboarding, activation, and reporting — reducing manual lift while increasing output
* Define and maintain program standards, SLAs, and intake processes across internal stakeholders and external partners
* Partner with legal, finance, and other internal and external partners to streamline contracting and payment operations globally


**Global Playbooks**


* Develop and maintain a suite of global playbooks covering influencer program application management, relationship tiering, campaign briefing, content guidelines, and performance benchmarking
* Localize frameworks for regional teams while preserving global consistency in brand standards and measurement methodology
* Establish best practices for new program verticals (e.g., live events, product launches, always\-on ambassador programs) and codify learnings into repeatable resources
* Train and enable cross\-functional partners and regional teams on playbook adoption

  


**CRM \& Tooling**


* Lead the buildout of a centralized influencer CRM and creator\-facing portal — defining data architecture, contact management standards, tagging taxonomy, and relationship history tracking
* Build, evaluate, implement, and own influencer marketing technology (CRM platforms, discovery tools, reporting dashboards) and serve as the internal subject matter expert
* Partner with data and analytics teams to develop dashboards that give real\-time visibility into program health, creator performance, and spend efficiency
* Ensure creator\-facing portal is dynamic and up to date with our backend updates, and tooling for influencers adoption and usage.
* Identify gaps in existing tooling and build or commission solutions that reduce friction and improve team output

  


**You have:**
-------------


* 8\-10 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or a closely related field, with at least 2 years in a role focused on operations, program management, or marketing technology
* Exceptional project management skills — highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a rapidly changing environment
* Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving influencer marketing infrastructure — playbooks, workflows, CRM systems, or reporting tools
* Comfort operating across global markets and working with regional teams to adapt centralized frameworks
* Strong analytical skills; able to work fluently with data to drive decisions and communicate program performance to leadership
* Clear, concise communicator who can translate complex operational concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences
* A bias toward building: you'd rather create a system than patch a problem
* Experience in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech — particularly with creator ecosystems tied to UGC or live platforms
* Familiarity with influencer contract structures, FTC guidelines, and international compliance considerations
* Background in or exposure to marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, or data pipeline basics
* Experience supporting large\-scale live events or product launches with influencer programming components


Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).



Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.



For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H\-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Quality, Safety & Regulatory
jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.  



Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)
**This is a Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

The Quality, Safety \& Regulatory Program Manager supports the Interventional and Procedural Services Platform by coordinating quality metrics, safety event follow\-up, regulatory readiness, infection prevention partnership, radiation/contrast/sedation safety tracking, high\-level disinfection oversight coordination, and procedural safety standards.
  

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of Quality and PI, the Program Manager works closely with the VP of Interventional Services, Senior Director of Procedural Nursing and Clinical Operations, Platform Medical Director, specialty medical directors, managers, Quality, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, Regulatory, Radiation Safety, Pharmacy, and other partners to ensure the platform has reliable quality infrastructure and visible accountability for improvement.
  

  

This role is intended to be a central integration point for procedural quality, safety, and regulatory work. The Coordinator does not replace department\-level accountability; rather, the role creates standard processes, dashboards, follow\-up discipline, and escalation pathways across OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post, and related procedural services.
  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley
  

  

**What you will do**

Quality Dashboard and Performance Monitoring


* Develop, maintain, and coordinate platform quality and safety dashboards for OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post/PACU/Procedural Recovery, and related procedural services.
* Track procedural quality indicators, infection prevention indicators, procedural complications, sedation events, radiation dose outliers, contrast events, unplanned transfers/admissions, retained item risks, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization biological indicator failures, and other agreed measures.
* Prepare routine reports for the Monthly Procedural Quality and Safety Committee, Interventional Services Executive Council, and leadership review.

Safety Event Review and Corrective Action Coordination


* Coordinate review, classification, follow\-up, and closure tracking for procedural safety events, near misses, regulatory findings, and improvement actions.
* Support root cause analysis, apparent cause analysis, action planning, audit design, and evidence collection in collaboration with Quality and Patient Safety partners.
* Ensure action plans have owners, timelines, evidence of completion, and sustainment measures.

Regulatory Readiness and Survey Support


* Coordinate procedural regulatory readiness activities, mock survey preparation, tracers, documentation audits, policy review, competency tracking evidence, and survey response support.
* Maintain readiness focus for surgical/procedural safety standards, sedation safety, high\-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation safety, contrast safety, medication safety, specimen handling, and SPD/sterilization processes.
* Partner with managers to identify gaps, escalate risks, and support timely corrective action.

Cross\-Functional Improvement and Standardization


* Support standardization of policies, procedures, checklists, audits, dashboards, and escalation pathways across procedural areas.
* Facilitate interdisciplinary improvement workgroups as assigned, including sedation safety, procedural verification, high\-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation/contrast safety, and SPD/OR reliability.
* Promote a Just Culture, high\-reliability principles, C\-I\-CARE, and transparent learning from events.

Key Performance Metrics


* Timeliness and completeness of quality dashboards, monthly reporting, action item closure, and sustainment audits.
* Safety event follow\-up completion, corrective action verification, regulatory readiness scores, audit completion, and survey finding closure.
* Performance trends in sedation safety, radiation/contrast safety, infection prevention, retained item risk, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization monitoring, and procedural complications.
* Manager and physician leader satisfaction with quality reporting, escalation visibility, and improvement support.

Employee must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the C\-I\-CARE Standards of the Hospital. C\-I\-CARE is the foundation of Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley’s patient experience and represents a framework for patient\-centered interactions.  



  

**Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, public health, clinical discipline, or related field required. Master’s degree preferred.

  

**Experience Qualifications**

* Minimum of four (4\) years of healthcare experience in quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, perioperative/procedural services, infection prevention, nursing, or clinical operations.
* Experience with quality dashboards, safety event analysis, regulatory surveys, infection prevention, high\-level disinfection, sedation safety, radiation or contrast safety, or procedural environments preferred.

  

**License/Certification**

* Clinical license preferred when applicable to candidate background. CPHQ, CPPS, CIC, or related quality/safety/regulatory certification preferred.

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Knowledge of healthcare quality, patient safety, regulatory standards, performance improvement, audit methods, and event follow\-up.
* Ability to work independently, organize complex cross\-functional work, and influence without direct authority.
* Strong data management, dashboard coordination,

jobs.title: Data Science Program Lead I - Neurology
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **About AbbVie**


AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

AbbVie Clinical Data Strategy and Operations is the best\-in\-class team within its cross\-industry peer group and is responsible for bringing people, process, and technology together to generate business value from clinical trials data. Our operational model is exemplified through execution and innovation. This role is key to ensuring successful delivery against the program\- and study\-level accountabilities assigned to Clinical Data Strategy and Operations (CDSO).


Responsibilities

* Aligns CDSO study teams with program\- and study\-level strategies. For assigned studies, leads the CDSO Study Team and represents DS as a member of the cross\-functional study team
* For assigned studies, acts as single point of contact and accountable operational lead from DSS. Coordinates associated DSS study teams to meet operational objectives. Engages and connects global functional and cross\-functional teams
* Interacts with and influences cross\-functional team members to achieve program and study objectives
* Utilizes operational analytics and project management tools to optimize execution of programs and studies, to manage internal and external resources, to track study progress, and to prepare study status reports. Anticipates and identifies issues that could affect timelines or quality and develops options and solutions
* Ensures adherence to federal regulations and applicable local regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and to functional quality standards. Stays abreast of new and/or evolving local regulations, guidelines and policies related to clinical development
* Participates in oversight of vendors and provides feedback related to study operations, issues, and trends in performance
* Responsible for coaching and mentoring Data Science Associates. May include indirect supervision of work for contract resources
* Participates in CDSO and cross\-functional innovation and process improvement initiatives
* Contributes to study execution “lessons learned” across functions

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, management information systems, computer science, life sciences or equivalent. Master’s preferred. PMP Certification or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt desired
* Must have at 3\+ years of pharma / clinical research / data management / health care experience or 5\+ years of project management experience (and / or applicable work experience)
* Strong understanding of clinical trial process and clinical technology. Experience in managing a clinical trial from initiation through to completion is preferred
* Demonstrated effective leadership skills
* Demonstrated ability to influence others without direct authority
* Demonstrated effective communication skills
* Demonstrated effective analytical skills

  

**Additional Information**  

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law:


* The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our short\-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.


AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

jobs.description:

The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.**

Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever\-forward mindset.**

Supports the effective operation, organization, and maintenance of marketing content systems, digital assets, and content governance processes. Coordinates content management activities that improve accessibility, consistency, usability, and alignment of marketing resources across the organization. Experience supporting content management systems, digital asset management platforms, marketing technologies, or enterprise content repositories preferred.
  

Experience supporting content governance processes, documentation practices, or workflow administration preferred.

No certifications or licenses required.

jobs.title: Assistant Critical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**THE COMPANY:**


STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience.


STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK.

**THE POSITION:**


STACK is looking for an Assistant Critical Operations Manager (ACOM) to support a local data center campus. As a leader in STACK’s Critical Operations team, the ACOM must possess an expert level of knowledge and will be responsible for assisting the Critical Operations Manager in maintaining the mechanical, electrical, fire life safety, base building, and other various internal data center systems. The ACOM will also be focused on the implementation of programs related to Safety, Team, Availability, Communication, and Knowledge. The Assistant Critical Operations Manager will report to the Critical Operations Manager.


The ACOM is responsible for the implementation of the Data Center Operations Program at their site and is responsible for employee training and ensuring all staff is adequately qualified to perform their duties. Holding regular team meetings and individual 1:1 sessions is required. The ACOM will assist the Critical Operations Manager in developing and maintaining CAPEX and OPEX budgets at the site level. They will also be responsible for project execution and management including developing scopes, obtaining proposals, creating purchase requisitions, and ensuring invoices are routed properly.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Lead and implement a standardized culture of always working safely across all STACK data centers.
* Serve as a datacenter subject matter expert for electrical, mechanical, fire life safety, and other data center systems.
* Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions within the facility.
* Implement site\-level efficiency projects and maintain overall site design PUE.
* Ensure STACK preventative and predictive maintenance program is executed.
* Train and mentor junior staff.
* Manage vendor relationships and service contracts.
* Assist in managing vendor procurement and billing processes.
* Support site budgeting and forecasting for both CapEx and OpEx.
* Create highly detailed technical procedures for maintenance events, emergency situations, and standard site evolutions.
* Perform expert technical review of procedures, company standards, and policies.
* Manage site audits, both internal and external, ensuring adherence to compliance standards.
* Manage systems to avoid unplanned, customer\-impacting outages.
* Manage the data floor and back\-of\-house mechanical loading capacity to ensure cooling system efficiency.
* Navigate and utilize CMS, EPMS, and BMS systems.
* Provide day\-to\-day exceptional customer service and support.
* Be available on\-call as required to respond to emergency situations at the data center.
* Perform other duties as required by STACK. Job duties, roles, and responsibilities are subject to change over time.

**THE DETAILS:**

* **Location: San Jose, CA**
* **Travel:** None or less than 5%
* **Benefits:** Healthcare, Dental Care, Vision Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Paid Leave Programs
* Must be eligible to work in the United States
* Must pass comprehensive background and drug screening

**MUST\-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Minimum of 4–5 years' experience in a data center or other related mission critical operations role
* Knowledge of data center (hyperscale, enterprise, and colocation) and telecommunications industries
* Experience working with Microsoft Office applications and database software
* 3–5 years' experience managing facility preventative maintenance programs
* 3–5 years' experience in vendor and project management
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and perform well in stressful situations
* Expert understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., UPS, Transformers, PDUs, RPPs, Chillers, CRAH, CRAC, STS, ATS, Pre\-action systems)
* Expert knowledge of NFPA70e, NFPA72, NFPA25, and fire life safety compliance standards
* Experience in data center trending and analysis with ability to learn PC\-based monitoring systems
* Proficiency in data center commissioning standards
* Ability to perform physical tasks including standing, walking, climbing, and lifting up to 25 pounds
* Willingness to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, and on\-call support
* Comfortable working in a high\-stress, fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities

**Compensation Range:**

$73\.00 \- $76\.50**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:**

* You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making.
* You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables.
* You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team.
* You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning.

**WHY STACK?**

* We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy.
* We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs.
* Fun is part of our DN

jobs.title: Protective Services Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Protective Services Operations Manager \- Northern California is responsible for the hands\-on management of the Company's residential security accounts and executive protection assignments throughout Northern California, with primary responsibility for the San Francisco Bay Area. This position owns day\-to\-day service delivery, staffing, field supervision, quality control, and client communication for the assigned portfolio.

This is a working management position requiring regular field presence and direct involvement in account launches, site visits, staffing challenges, training, advances, and time\-sensitive protection assignments. When management demand permits, the Manager may personally support billable executive protection assignments, advances, training, or emergency coverage. Success is measured by service quality, staffing stability, client satisfaction, field engagement, responsiveness, and financial performance.

**Responsibilities**

**Operational \& Account Management:**

* Manage the day\-to\-day performance of assigned residential security accounts and protective services operations.
* Maintain direct awareness of staffing, scheduling, post activity, incidents, client expectations, and open operational issues.
* Review schedules, overtime, callouts, and deployment practices each week to ensure reliable coverage and efficient use of personnel.
* Serve as the primary operational escalation point for assigned clients, site leaders, security personnel, and after\-hours issues.
* Conduct scheduled and unannounced site visits, post inspections, and service reviews, documenting findings and corrective actions.
* Lead account launches, transitions, special projects, and corrective action plans in coordination with company leadership.

**Ad Hoc Executive Protection:**

* Receive, plan, staff, and oversee short\-notice and scheduled executive protection assignments throughout Northern California.
* Confirm scope, protective requirements, agent qualifications, schedules, transportation, communications, and reporting expectations before deployment.
* Conduct or assign advances and coordinate directly with clients, agents, vendors, venues, and local partners as required.

**Field Leadership \& Quality Control:**

* Maintain a consistent field presence and work directly with site leaders and agents to reinforce standards, post orders, and client expectations.
* Ensure post orders, emergency procedures, training records, schedules, contact rosters, and account documentation remain current.
* Personally assist with assignments, training, account launches, and emergency coverage when operationally necessary and appropriately qualified.

**Team Management \& Development:**

* Lead, coach, and hold accountable site leaders, supervisors, and security personnel assigned to the Northern California portfolio.
* Conduct performance evaluations, provide timely feedback, recognize strong performance, and address service or conduct concerns promptly.
* Coordinate required training, drills, and readiness evaluations for residential security and executive protection personnel.
* Partner with Human Resources on employee relations, investigations, disciplinary action, and separations when required.

**Recruiting \& Staffing:**

* Support recruiting, interviewing, selection, onboarding, and deployment of qualified residential security and executive protection personnel.
* Develop and maintain a reliable bench of vetted personnel capable of supporting planned assignments, callouts, and short\-notice requests.

**Client Service \& Communication:**

* Maintain regular communication with each assigned client or designated representative and respond promptly to requests and concerns.
* Conduct periodic account reviews, track commitments, and ensure issues are resolved or escalated through the appropriate leadership channel.
* Identify changes in client needs, scope, or risk and communicate potential service or commercial impacts to executive leadership.

**Compliance \& Financial Performance:**

* Ensure assigned operations comply with company policies, client requirements, licensing standards, and applicable laws and regulations.
* Review incident reports, timekeeping, expenses, overtime, and other account activity for accuracy, timeliness, and operational follow\-through.
* Monitor account performance and recommend improvements to service delivery, staffing, resource allocation, and profitability.
* Maintain direct awareness of staffing, scheduling, post activity, incidents, client expectations, and open operational issues.
* Review schedules, overtime, callouts, and deployment practices each week to ensure reliable coverage and efficient use of personnel.
* Serve as the primary operational escalation point for assigned clients, site leaders, security personnel, and after\-hours issues.
* Conduct scheduled and unannounced site visits, post inspections, and service reviews, documenting findings and corrective actions.
* Lead account launches, transitions, special projects, and corrective action plans in coordination with company leadership.

**Qualifications:**

* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent military, law enforcement, security, or operational leadership experience may be substituted.
* Experience: Minimum of 7 years of relevant security, military, law enforcement, executive protection, or residential security experience, including at least 3 years leading personnel or client accounts.

jobs.description:
**Event Operations Manager**

**Location:** California (Bay Area/San Jose) (Regional travel required)

**Contract:** Weekly / Event\-Based. Average 16\-30 hrs per week.

**Rate of Pay:** $28 per hour

**About XL Event Lab**

XL Event Lab is an international live events company producing a portfolio of successful

touring entertainment experiences across multiple markets.

As we continue to expand across North America, we're looking for an Event Operations

Manager to help deliver exceptional live events throughout California (Bay Area/San Jose).

**The Role**

Reporting to the Head of Regional Development – Live Events, you'll take responsibility

for the operational delivery of our events once venues have been secured. From planning

and preparation through to the final guest leaving the venue, you'll ensure every event is

delivered safely, professionally and to an exceptional standard.

This is a practical, hands\-on role. You'll lead Event Crew, transport equipment, liaise with

venues, solve problems as they arise and ensure every event delivers a first\-class guest

experience.

If you enjoy leading people, thrive in fast\-paced environments and aren't afraid to roll up your sleeves, we'd love to hear from you.

***What You'll Be Doing***

**Event Delivery**

* Lead the operational delivery of live events across your region.
* Act as the operational lead on event day.
* Ensure events run safely, efficiently and on schedule.
* Resolve operational issues quickly and professionally.

**Venue Operations**

* Take ownership of venue operations following contract confirmation.
* Liaise directly with venue staff before and during each event.
* Ensure all operational requirements are in place ahead of every event.

**Team Leadership**

* Schedule Event Crew for upcoming events.
* Lead pre\-event briefings and provide direction throughout each event.
* Foster a positive, professional team environment.

**Equipment \& Logistics**

* Transport event equipment to and from venues using a U\-Haul vehicle.
* Manage event setup and pack\-down.
* Maintain equipment and monitor inventory levels.

**Guest Experience**

* Deliver an outstanding customer experience from arrival through to departure.
* Handle guest queries and resolve issues professionally.
* Represent XL Event Lab and our event brands to the highest standard.

**About You**

You'll be organised, dependable and comfortable taking responsibility for live events.

Previous experience in live events would be advantageous, but we'd also welcome

candidates from hospitality, visitor attractions, theatres, tourism or similar customer\-facing

environments.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy working as part of a team, take pride in delivering exceptional

experiences and remain calm under pressure.

**Working Pattern**

This role is centered around our live event schedule.

Most work takes place on Fridays and Saturdays, with occasional Thursday and Sunday

events depending on the tour schedule. Hours will average between 16\-30 each week.

Regular travel throughout California is required, with overnight stays only occasionally

necessary.

**Why Join XL Event Lab?**

* Join an established international live events company.
* Play a key role in delivering memorable live experiences.
* Work in a varied, hands\-on role where no two event days are the same.
* Become part of a growing business with ambitious plans across North America.

Pay: $28\.00 per hour

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Medsien** is the leading provider of scalable remote care management for a quality patient experience. Hundreds of organizations trust Medsien's unparalleled technology solutions to implement exceptional remote care management programs, personalize every interaction, and improve the lives of the people who need it most. Based in San Francisco and venture\-backed by top\-tier investors, Medsien was founded to reimagine remote care management.



More than 60% of all U.S. adults\-over 150 million people\-live with at least one chronic condition, which requires dedicated, ongoing medical support outside the four walls of their doctor's office. And yet, only 20% of these patients have access to remote care from the comfort of their homes, putting their health at significant risk.



Our vision is to provide better access to care. We want to see a world where no chronic condition is an obstacle to a happy life.



We're seeking an experienced **Clinical Operations Manager** to work closely with senior leadership and lead a team of medical assistants and care coordinators, proactively supporting, developing, and improving processes across the clinical team. This position reports directly to the Director of Operations.



As the **Clinical Operations Manager**, you will:


* Directly manage a remote team of medical assistants, providing guidance, support, and regular feedback,
* Manage daily operations of clinical staff, including planning, goal setting, and quality assurance,
* Design and improve specific operational processes and guidelines to ensure high clinical quality and service excellence in patient care,
* Collaborate with the leadership and other stakeholders to implement policies and procedures and provide adequate oversight,
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators to measure success and engagement across different teams and with different external partners,
* Participate in hiring, training, and onboarding of new staff,
* Assign and delegate tasks to the medical assistants based on their expertise and workload, ensuring optimal resource utilization,
* Conduct performance evaluations, identify areas for improvement, and provide coaching and training as needed,
* Develop and implement efficient workflows and processes to maximize the quality and efficiency of patient care.


**Please apply if you have:**


* Experience managing multiple departments or functions, preferably with responsibility for building those departments from the ground up,
* Experience building teams, processes, workflows, and SOPs rather than simply managing an established operation,
* Strong cross\-functional management experience and the ability to support multiple departments simultaneously,
* Demonstrated ability to identify operational bottlenecks and implement solutions,
* Experience with resource allocation, staffing, capacity planning, and coverage across teams,
* Strong people\-management skills, including coaching managers and individual contributors,
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of problems without requiring significant direction,
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities,
* Experience using KPIs, metrics, and data to manage team performance and operational efficiency,
* Demonstrated process improvement experience with measurable results,
* 5\+ years of experience managing employees, including performance and day\-to\-day operational oversight in a clinical setting,
* Background in nursing, care management or clinical operations,
* Excellent communication skills,
* Strong organization and project management skills; ability to prioritize, organize, plan, and implement services as well as handle multiple projects/problems simultaneously,
* Desire to work at an early\-stage startup and comfort with associated uncertainty and rolling up your sleeves to get things done,
* Proficiency in HIPAA and CMS regulatory requirements,
* BA/BS degree,
* Residence in the US.


Some **nice\-to\-have** qualifications include experience in:


* Healthcare or clinical operations,
* Managing support, shared\-services, or operational enablement teams,
* Managing a float pool or shared staffing model,
* Scaling multiple departments during rapid growth,
* Implementing technology or automation to improve operational efficiency,
* Working in a startup or rapidly changing organization,
* Creating a new department or operational function from the ground up.


**For this position, we offer:**


* Competitive salary,
* Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage,
* Flexible vacation and PTO policies,
* Fully remote work opportunities,
* Training, mentorship, and coaching from leadership.


**Our Process**



We will review your application along with all the others we receive and pick the top profiles for a screening call. In many cases due to time constraints and our candidate volume, only the short\-listed candidates are contacted but we do consider each application carefully. If you have been selected as a short\-listed candidate, we will contact you for a short screening call to get to know you better. If you don't get a call, please don't be disappointed! We receive many applications for each role and must prioritize who we speak to.



Employment at **Medsien** is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national or ethnic origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, age, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
With a network of nearly 200 branches, Loomis armored transportation, cash management centers, and cash inventory vaults keep cash flowing throughout financial institutions and retail businesses across the US. Loomis prides itself on providing employees with opportunities for career advancement and job satisfaction. In fact, many of our company’s managers, vice presidents, and corporate executives started out in the branches as driver/guards and tellers. Our work can be challenging, but the thousands who have stayed with our company for decades will tell you that if you have the desire to learn and the drive to succeed, Loomis is the place to be. Come join our team!
  
  

**Job Overview:** The Operations Supervisor will be responsible for implementing and administering Loomis policies and procedures, monitoring and controlling daily operations, and assisting with the long\-term operation of armored car routes and the cash vault. The Operations Supervisor will work alongside Management to develop, maintain, and supervise a professional, employee\-centered culture, a safe and secure operation, high service delivery, and cost\-effective, productive operations. This includes operational responsibility for all route operations (armored and ATM), and for vault and facility security operations, as directed by the Operations Manager/Branch Manager.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Complete and maintain scheduling/routing on a daily basis.
* Oversight and coordination of armored and ATM routes, dispatch, first\-line ATM maintenance, vault, and terminal operations.
* Maintaining effectiveness and efficiency of route, terminal, and vault operations.
* Safety of employees, vehicles, and facilities through training, monitoring, and enforcement of policies and procedures
* Security of cargo and terminal through training, monitoring, and enforcement of policies and procedures, including terminal opening and closing.
* Investigating accidents and processing required paperwork.
* Developing and maintaining customer service capabilities among all operations staff.
* Responding to customer inquiries and/or complaints and solving logistical issues.
* Coordinating with sales, other Division branches and departments, Division and corporate staff, other carriers, and vendors in creating and implementing viable operational solutions to new customers.
* Controlling overtime hours. Monitoring employee vacation schedules.
* Maintaining the effectiveness and efficiency of operational functions.
* Communication with all employees to immediately resolve any outstanding issues and/or complaints.

* Provide leadership that is dedicated to professionalism, continuous improvement, and exceeding challenging goals and objectives.
* Recruiting, interviewing, testing, selecting, training, and supervising operations personnel.
* Oversight and coordination of maintenance of vehicles, forklifts, and other equipment.
* Emergency response, including response to employee injuries, facility security incidents, vehicle incidents, and security investigations.
* Manipulation and maintenance of route and vault data to include manual paperwork and electronic data.

**Primary Qualifications:**  

* Ability to obtain a valid firearms permit.
* Must have 3\+ years’ experience in transportation and warehousing, transportation logistics, or a related field.
* Minimum 2\+ years of proven professional supervisory and leadership experience.

* Strong desire to succeed, advance your career, and work for a company\-leading branch.


**Individual Skills \& Competencies:**  

* Strong leadership skills with the ability to manage and develop high\-performing teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to teach, coach, and present to small and large groups.
* Excellent computer skills and a working knowledge of Microsoft Office programs.


**Benefits:**  

Loomis offers one of the most comprehensive employee benefits packages in the industry, which includes:
  
* Vacation and Sick Time (PTO), as well as Paid Holidays
* Health \& Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Plan
* Basic Life Insurance Plan
* Voluntary Life Insurance Plan
* Flexible Spending and Health Savings Account

* Industry\-leading Training and Development

jobs.title: Platform Program Manager, AMP Partner Operations
jobs.description:
Apple’s Partner Operations team is seeking an experienced, highly collaborative, and technically astute Program Manager to lead platform capability expansion across our Apple services partnerships.  

  

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will bridge business strategy, technical integration, and partner execution. You will guide global partners\-spanning telecommunications carriers, subscription video on demand (SVOD) providers, and retail integrators\-through the onboarding lifecycle, ensuring they can seamlessly adopt new platform capabilities. You will operate comfortably in the gray, translate complex commerce and linking architectures into actionable operational workflows, and drive alignment across Business Development, Engineering, Product, QA, Marketing, Legal, and more. You will also continue to refine parter onboarding and management processes and tools, utilizing innovative approaches \- knowing when to use technical tools such as AI while understanding the necessity for face to face collaboration. ","responsibilities":"You will own the end\-to\-end operational lifecycle for new platform features and major partner launches. Your core responsibilities include:  

  

Platform Capability \& Feature Onboarding  

  

Drive Partner Adoption of Platform Capabilities: Lead the operational rollout and partner adoption for emerging features to our billing platform.  

  

Partner with product and engineering teams to establish operational readiness for novel subscription bundling models (e.g., streaming and carrier bundles), tier upgrades/downgrades via update\-entitlement APIs, and multi\-country configurations.  

  

Define Migration \& Sunset Flows (CIP to Direct): Own the Partner Ops workstream for transitioning subscribers between partner\-billed and Apple\-direct models, defining end\-to\-end operational requirements, PVT validation flows, and subscription cancellation/revocation procedures.  

  

Technical Operations  

  

Lead Production Verification \& Testing Strategy: Partner with Commerce QA and Central Marketing UAT to define and execute comprehensive PVT plans; coordinate partner dependencies, including test SIM sourcing, test accounts, and allowlisting.  

  

Investigate Discrepancies \& Resolve Blockers: Triage operational and technical blockers impacting partner launches (e.g., deep\-link localization/offer sheet display issues, tax ID formatting on partner invoicing, missing commerce signals, and account unlinking edge cases).  

  

Operational Infrastructure \& Scalability  

  

Oversee intake trackers from the partner ops team and roadmap requests for platform enhancements; prioritize requests with engineering and product teams to balance partner velocity with long\-term platform health.  

  

Standardize Governance \& Enablement: Partner with regional teams (AMR, EMEIA, APAC) and integrators to deliver consistent integration best practices, partner capability trackers, and onboarding toolkits.  

  

Drive Process Automation: Identify manual intervention points across the onboarding lifecycle and work cross\-functionally to transition them into automated, self\-serve, and scalable tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

BA/BS degree required; technical, engineering, or business operations background preferred.  

  

8\+ years of relevant industry experience in technical program management, partner operations, or systems integration.  

  

Experience in telecommunications carrier billing, digital streaming services (OTT/SVOD), or digital commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

8\+ years of technical program or operations management experience driving complex, partner\-facing integrations, digital customer journeys, and back\-end platform capabilities.  

  

Deep familiarity with subscription lifecycle mechanics, recurring billing, and API\-driven partner integrations  

  

Proven track record in end\-to\-end partner onboarding \& operational readiness, from defining intake processes and writing operational requirements to coordinating production verification testing (PVT/UAT).  

  

Strong cross\-functional orchestration skills, with the demonstrated ability to lead workstreams across Engineering, Product, Business Development, Commerce/Billing, Legal/Privacy, and Regional Operations teams globally.  

  

Strong analytical and problem\-solving aptitude, with experience troubleshooting back\-end event triggers, signaling mechanisms, and data\-flow discrepancies across multi\-party ecosystems.  

  

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, capable of presenting technical concepts clearly to executive leadership, authoring partner\-facing integration guides, and managing multi\-stakeholder operational reviews.  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $149,200 and $249,000, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

jobs.title: Project Assistant, AI Enablement
jobs.description:
**EHDD is looking for someone who gets architects and gets AI.**


EHDD is an 80\-year\-old, design\-forward practice with deep sustainability roots and a real appetite to lead, not follow, on how AI reshapes architectural practice. We're looking for someone to help us get there.


You'll be embedded within project teams, connecting coding and AI tools to real workflows and identify opportunities for efficiency and key workflows to target for automation.

 **What You'd Do**

* Partner directly with the team on our AI strategy and adoption roadmap
* Be the go\-to person connecting coding/AI tools to real workflows across our MS 365 stack, including Copilot and Power Automate
* Pilot, test, and roll out AI tools across project management, design, documentation, visualization, accounting, marketing, and project delivery. Teach the firm how to actually use them.
* Drive adoption through training, documentation, and ongoing support to ensure new tools become part of everyday practice
* Track and communicate the impact of new tools and workflows through metrics such as time savings, user adoption, project efficiency, and information quality
* Capture and share successful workflows, templates, prompts, and lessons learned to build the firm's collective knowledge base
* Project administration tasks such as:
	+ Assisting with project startup and closeout
	+ Preparing milestone documents with the design team and consultants
	+ Maintaining design team directories in MS Teams and TonicDM
	+ Managing design team access to MS Teams, Bluebeam, and other platforms
	+ Reinforcing file naming, metadata, and organization standards across platforms

**What You Bring**

* Attention to detail and strong ownership of problems and situations, from start to finish
* Genuine tech curiosity and self\-starter energy \- you go find the answer before someone asks you to
* Comfort, ideally fluency, in MS 365 and Claude; Revit knowledge is a plus, along with general ease across creative/visualization and collaboration tools
* Strong communication \- you can explain a workflow fix to a team, and a technical constraint to IT, in the same afternoon
* Architecture, engineering, or construction (AEC) practice experience is strongly preferred. You're embedded on project teams day to day, so firsthand knowledge of how projects actually run matters, even as strong tech instincts are the priority
* Working knowledge of project management, design, documentation, and project delivery workflows and deliverables
* Strong technology judgment and systems thinking \- you understand not just how to use tools, but when and why a particular platform, database, automation, or AI solution is the right fit
* Ability to balance innovation with practicality, focusing on solutions that teams will actually adopt and maintain

 **What Matters Most**


Energy, communication skills, curiosity, and the ability to lead from the middle. This is a partner in a team seat, someone who earns trust project by project, not a mandate from above.

 **What We Offer**


EHDD is an award\-winning, majority woman\-owned firm providing architecture, interiors, planning, and urban design services. We offer competitive benefits, including medical/dental/vision insurance with HSA, transportation benefits, and professional development support.


Notable projects include the Eames Institute, the AIA Headquarters Renewal, YouTube Headquarters, Monterey Bay Aquarium, The Exploratorium, Goldendale Observatory, and Point Defiance Zoo Aquarium.

*We are an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans are encouraged to apply.*

 **Application Process**


Submit a resume and a letter of interest describing your relevant project administration, technology, and AI/automation experience. Work samples that show a workflow, tool, or process you've built or improved are welcome but not required.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Within SSOE’s Advanced Technology division, we specialize in high\-tech facility design, offering top\-tier design and engineering services to a diverse array of clients and markets. Our team is composed of highly skilled and knowledgeable professionals who excel across various disciplines. We pride ourselves on our cross\-disciplinary approach, which allows us to understand and address our clients' needs more comprehensively than traditional, siloed methods. What sets us apart is our ability to seamlessly conceptualize, plan, and detail every aspect of design. Our in\-house experts collaborate closely, optimizing and enhancing our work through multi\-discipline strategy sessions. By leveraging cutting\-edge techniques and state\-of\-the\-art software, we deliver industry\-leading technology and innovative solutions from day one.  

The **Senior Project Manager** leads complex, multidisciplinary design and delivery efforts for advanced technology facilities, with a focus on cleanroom environments, fab support systems, and high\-tech industrial infrastructure. This role manages scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk across all phases of delivery, from early planning and basis of design through construction administration. The Senior Project Manager works closely with clients, discipline leads, subconsultants, and internal project teams to coordinate technical decisions, review design packages, resolve field issues, and maintain project momentum. The role also drives change management, best practices, and proactive communication to support predictable, high\-quality project outcomes in fast\-moving, highly regulated environments.
AI and Innovation:

At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows.
Responsibilities:
* Lead planning and execution of complex semiconductor and advanced technology facility projects from pre\-design through construction administration, ensuring alignment with client objectives, technical requirements, and project delivery milestones.
* Develop and manage project scope, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and execution strategies for large, multidisciplinary design and construction efforts, including design\-build and integrated project delivery environments.
* Coordinate with discipline leads in mechanical, electrical, plumbing, structural, process, controls, and architectural teams to integrate cleanroom, fab support, utility, and high\-performance building systems into cohesive project deliverables.
* Guide basis of design development, design narratives, engineering calculations, and technical reviews for facility systems and mission\-critical infrastructure.
* Oversee QA/QC review gates, interdisciplinary coordination, and milestone deliverable reviews to ensure accuracy, constructability, code compliance, and alignment with client standards and operational requirements.
* Manage client communication and decision\-making throughout the project lifecycle, including executive reporting, design reviews, issue resolution, and presentation of technical impacts.
* Direct change management processes, including scope evaluation, budget and schedule impact analysis, contingency planning, and negotiation of modifications with clients, contractors, and internal teams.
* Coordinate with vendors, equipment suppliers, and specialty consultants to support equipment integration, procurement planning, utility interfaces, and technical submittal review for critical systems and long\-lead items.
* Lead construction administration activities such as RFIs, submittals, field observations, site walks, punch list coordination, and resolution of design or installation issues during construction and turnover.
* Identify project risks early and implement mitigation strategies related to design complexity, schedule constraints, phased occupancy, safety, permitting, and operational continuity.
* Promote a strong safety culture by coordinating with project teams and contractors to address life safety, construction safety, and operational risk considerations throughout project delivery.
* Mentor project team members and emerging project managers, reinforcing best practices in communication, technical coordination, documentation control, and client service.
* Contribute to pursuit support, proposal development, and project planning efforts for new semiconductor and advanced technology opportunities as needed.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil/Structural, or a closely related technical discipline is hihgly preferred.
* Demonstrated project management experience of 10 or more years, with significant focus on the design and delivery of industrial, advanced technology, or high\-tech manufacturing facilities such as semiconductor fabrication facilities, data centers, or similar mission\-critical environments.
* Proven experience leading projects in a design\-build or integrated project delivery environment, with responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client satisfaction.
* Strong technical understanding of facility systems commonly used in semiconductor and advanced technology projects, such as cleanroom design, HVAC, process utilities, power distribution, plumbing, and building support systems.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and managing complex interfaces among owners, architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and commissioning partners.
* Working knowledge of project controls, change management, risk management, QA/QC processes, and construction administr

jobs.description:
**Description**  



  

**PROJECT MANAGER**  

*This position is based out of Mutiple locations.*  

  

**About ArchKey**  

  

ArchKey is one of the nation’s largest privately held specialty trade installation and integrated facility service companies. We are a leader in designing, building and maintaining electrical, technologies and specialty systems. We’re the POWER behind making the improbable possible.
  

  

We’re electrifying the nation, energizing the future and bringing communities to life like never before. What we do today shapes the vision of tomorrow. Our work impacts lives long after the building is done. This means we are committed to building in ways that are not just technologically advanced, but sustainable, scalable and equitable by all. We’re not just energizing infrastructure, we’re energizing careers, communities, and the future.
  

  

Made up of the brightest minds in the industry, our team is our greatest asset, bringing knowledge, skills, and experience to every project. This is more than a call to join us, it’s an invitation to be part of a visionary journey, to grow with us as we scale.  

  

**About the Position**  

  

As a Project Manager, you will support the planning, execution, and financial performance of electrical construction projects while coordinating project teams, field leadership, and clients to deliver successful outcomes. Project Managers may independently lead smaller projects or work alongside Senior Project Managers or Project Directors on larger and more complex projects.  

  

This role provides an opportunity to further develop project leadership skills while supporting the delivery of increasingly complex electrical construction projects. As Project Managers gain experience and demonstrate strong performance, they may progress into Senior Project Manager roles with expanded leadership responsibility for larger and more complex projects.  

  

**Our Ideal Candidate**  

* Can flex and adapt to the growing needs of the business.
* Can work autonomously and creatively solve problems.
* Has a growth mindset and is always looking to continually learn and grow.

  

**Day in the Life**  

* Partners with leadership to provide strategic input to key objectives and decisions affecting the business unit and functional work group. Conducts high\-quality business development and job solicitation in the marketplace, in partnership with other Company leaders. Provides ongoing quality reviews and project communication with owners, contractors, designers, subcontractors, engineers, architects, field staff, and other customers or stakeholders, addressing and resolving issues when needed.
* Serve as the overall project leader for large commercial and industrial electrical construction projects, responsible for the successful delivery of scope, schedule, budget, and safety performance.
* Lead and align the project team, including project managers, engineers, and field leadership, ensuring strong coordination between office and field operations.
* Support preconstruction and pursuit efforts, including estimating input, scope development, value engineering, and participation in contract negotiations
* Lead project planning and execution, including staffing strategy, procurement planning, schedule development, and coordination with engineering and field teams.
* Oversee project financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and change order management.
* Manage client and partner relationships, serving as a primary point of contact for owners, general contractors, and key project stakeholders.
* Provide leadership for project safety, reinforcing company safety programs and expectations across all project activities.
* Lead contract administration and risk management, including major procurement decisions, subcontract strategy, and change management.
* Ensure effective management of project construction documents, including drawings, specifications, RFIs, submittals, and revisions, ensuring field teams are working from the most current issued information.
* Maintain a working understanding of IBEW labor agreements, supporting coordination with union leadership and compliance with applicable labor standards.

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in electrical, mechanical, or civil engineering, project management, business administration, construction management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of project management experience. Extensive project management training and skills—thorough understanding of the project life cycle.
* Minimum 2 years of project management work experience in construction (electrical distribution/substation, renewable energy or related disciplines).
* Experience with computerized estimating systems and software, preferably Accubid. Experience and proficiency using Accubid, Revit, CAD, SKM, ADGI, Navisworks, and/or BIM systems is a plus.
* Trained and proficient in project management tools and techniques, negotiating, budgeting, estimating, costing, contracting, scheduling, pricing, and common code requirements. Strong business analysis and mathematical skills. Show ability to diagnose complex problems with strategic critical thinking skills and detail orientation, and to drive appropriate solutions with self\-initiative and sensitivity.
* Knowledge of and proficiency with construction methods and materials, costing, power, lighting, systems design, and general industry safety and OSHA standards, procedures, and regulations. Keen understanding of the National Electric Code. Skills to read, interpret and understand financial documents, electrical bids, contracts, plans, drawings, blueprints, and specifications.
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to lead project teams and coordinate with clients, contractors, and field leadership.
* Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and general electrica

**Description**  

  

In this role, you will serve as the central operational backbone\-wrangling timelines, leading executive reviews, and ensuring seamless content access for AI models. You will orchestrate program operations, from establishing governance frameworks and tracking negotiation pipelines to coordinating Business and partner team support. You have a natural inclination to take accountability for end\-to\-end delivery, proactively surface silent risks, and drive decisions across matrixed leadership. Drive real\-time status reporting to monitor program health, legal compliance, contract execution milestones, and overall program and launch readiness

Partner closely with the Business lead to track outreach statuses, regional nuances, and negotiation stages, ensuring full visibility across all business workstreams  

  

Coordinate cross\-functional touchpoints to resolve legal redlines, payment workflow blockers, and localization issues quickly  

  

Lead executive meeting preparation by curating agendas, synthesizing weekly progress reports, facilitating briefings, and developing executive\-ready presentation decks  

  

Facilitate recurring syncs, working group meetings, and business reviews across AIML, Siri, Apps, Legal, and other partner organizations  

  

Drive action items, follow\-through, and accountability across all participating teams and leadership layers  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

  

Experience in financial operations, AI and search environments, or business development contexts  

  

Outstanding organizational and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex, ambiguous situations into clear narratives for leadership  

  

Skilled in building and maintaining relationships with internal cross\-functional teams  

  

Solid track record of driving multiple concurrent, high\-complexity cross\-functional projects to completion under tight timelines  

  

Demonstrated sense of urgency and ownership when resolving blockers, with the resilience to stay the course on broader business priorities  

  

Executive presence and comfort presenting to senior and executive leadership in high\-pressure settings  

  

Comfort with metrics, operational reporting, and the full software product lifecycle from concept through launch  

  

Ability to anticipate downstream problems, brainstorm solutions quickly, and resolve cross\-team friction without losing sight of strategic objectives  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**  

  

6\+ years of experience in Business Operations, Planning, or Program Management, with a clear track record of increasing operational responsibility  

  

Demonstrated ability to manage complex portfolios with intricate delivery schedules and cross\-team dependencies spanning global time zones and locales  

  

Proven experience translating nuanced legal and business considerations into actionable requirements that engineering and product teams can execute against  

  

Track record of orchestrating multi\-disciplinary teams with divergent goals toward unified program outcomes  

  

Proficiency with modern productivity and AI tools, including demonstrated experience leveraging AI and automation to create workflow efficiencies and reduce manual overhead  

  

Strong comfort in executive stakeholder communication, including developing briefing materials, presentation decks, and synthesized status reports for senior leadership  

  

Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a comparable operations or program management capacity  

  

**Pay \& Benefits**  

  

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,500 and $263,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  

  

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  

  

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

At Lumenis, you'll have the opportunity to represent industry\-leading technology, work alongside ambitious professionals, and build a career with a company that continues to shape the future of medical innovation.


We're growing fast \- and we're looking for ambitious, competitive, relationship\-driven sales professionals who want to build a career with a market leader

**Job Purpose:** The Installation \& Training Coordinator plays a critical role within Lumenis, responsible for delivering seamless, efficient, and positive customer experience throughout the onboarding and service process. Additionally, the role leverages AI\-powered tools and technology to enhance customer communications, streamline processes, provide timely support, and improve overall operational efficiency.

	+ Manage and maintain schedules for Customer Engineers and Clinical Trainers, coordinating installation timelines and ensuring smooth operations.
* **Problem Resolution \& Troubleshooting:**

	+ Take proactive steps to mitigate potential delays, ensuring minimal disruption to the customer experience.
	+ Escalate complex issues or concerns to management as necessary, ensuring that problems are addressed promptly and satisfactorily.
* **Process Improvement \& Feedback:**

	+ Ensure that all customer data is updated and accurate to help streamline communication and prevent errors.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:**
* + Work closely with the Customer Experience/Installation Manager to execute departmental strategies and initiatives.
	+ Ensure alignment with the overall customer journey by communicating effectively with internal teams and supporting leadership in achieving customer success goals.
* **Adherence to Policies and Standards:**
* + Ensure compliance with all company policies and standards in every aspect of customer interaction.
	+ Maintain a professional, customer\-first mindset while balancing the need for operational efficiency.

* Minimum of 3 years of experience in customer experience, scheduling, or service coordination.
* Proven experience in managing customer inquiries, scheduling, logistics, sales order management, and delivering high\-quality customer support.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to handle diverse customer situations effectively.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team, demonstrating accountability and reliability.

jobs.title: Partner Engagement Program Manager, Partner Plex
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in a management consulting, sales operations, business strategy or corporate advisory role.
* Experience operating an event/conference venue or briefing center for an organization.
* Experience in project or program management.
* Experience crafting and delivering communications, narratives, and status updates for executive leadership or executive stakeholders.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience creating or managing executive\-focused events and experiences.
* Ability to proactively adjust and improve processes that will benefit not only our customers, but also the internal executives.
* Ability to prioritize workloads, quickly transition between projects, and adapt to unanticipated issues that arise with grace and agility to ensure positive customer experience.
* Strong attention to detail that creates a positive and lasting experience for customers.
* Strong cultural awareness that can give context on how to better host groups from all over the world.
* Thrive in a team environment and always strive for higher standards.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Business Strategy \& Operations organization provides business critical insights using analytics, ensures cross functional alignment of goals and execution, and helps teams drive strategic partnerships and new initiatives forward. We stay focused on aligning the highest\-level company priorities with effective day\-to\-day operations, and help evolve early stage ideas into future\-growth initiatives.



The Partner Engagement team enables meaningful executive\-level interactions that drive forward Google’s strategic cross\-product area objectives. We help craft memorable executive engagements with partner C\-level that showcase our OneGoogle approach and position Google as the long\-term AI transformation partner of choice.


We are seeking a customer experience visionary and execution\-focused Program Manager to lead event operations for our flagship Executive Briefing Center (EBC), the Google Partner Plex, at our headquarters in Mountain View. The Partner Plex hosts Google’s most strategic business engagements with C\-level executives and key opinion formers from around the world.
  

  

As a Partner Plex Program Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring our on\-site operations. Additional responsibilities include (but are not limited to): co\-hosting tours of the space for Googler executives and their guests, overseeing the local concierge team and partnering with their vendor management, developing a process with on\-site teams to review all meeting spaces regularly to ensure the space is always customer\-ready, own swag vendor relationship and development of custom swag per location by tier. You will also partner with the catering team on elevated event offerings, budget oversight, and manage relationships with security teams for sweeps and extra support as necessary. You will possess strong written and verbal communication skills for a variety of audiences.


The Global Partnerships organization is responsible for exploring new opportunities with Google's partners. Google’s Global Partnerships team works with a wide range of partners to bring the best of Google to power their business. The Global Partnerships team supports Google’s own Product teams with essential partnerships to help Google’s user experiences in advertising, Search, Assistant, Maps, Travel, Shopping, Payments and more. Teams create product\-enabling partnerships, go\-to\-market strategies and incubate business growth for a variety of products.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $152000 \- $221000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Manage the customer experience and oversee daily operations, including escalations, logistics, operations support, space usage, budget support, future\-proofing, and guidelines to support the center.
* Serve as the local Point of Contact (POC) for our service lines, guiding the team around process changes, escalations, and own logistics\-only briefings in collaboration with the Coordinator team.
* Lead remodels, as necessary, from a program management perspective and stay informed on the budget allocation in partnership with our cross\-functional partners (e.g. REWS, gTech, Large Customer Sales (LCS)).
* Partner with event venue specialists, catering, and security coordinators to review on\-site logistics, menus, and security needs for upcoming engagements.
* Build relationships, manage cross\-functional stakeholders, and drive alignment without direct authority/influence while remaining organized, analytical, and a creative problem solver.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law.
