jobs.title: Dental Member Services Coordinator I, 3050
jobs.description:
**POSITION: Dental Member Services Coordinator I**  

**DEPARTMENT: Dental**  

**REPORTS TO: Senior Dental Clinic Manager**  

**LOCATION: Native American Health Center (NAHC)**  

**3050 International Blvd., Oakland, CA 94601**  

**WORK HOURS: Full Time, 40 hours per week, 100% FTE**  

**STATUS: Union, Non\-Exempt**




**POSITION SUMMARY**  

The Dental Member Service Coordinator I (DMSC I) is a member of a multi\-disciplinary team dedicated to delivering high quality member care, exceptional customer service and aiding members in accessing dental services. DMSC I’s are assigned specific responsibilities that pertain to particular sites, programs, and departments. These responsibilities may encompass data entry, maintaining logs, participating in meetings, assisting with audits, and providing support to other locations. The DMSCI will engage with various systems, including Electronic Health Records, Electronic Dental Records and multiple texting platforms, while assisting members directly and managing the phone system.


The DMSC I will explain treatment plans, discuss procedures, address concerns, and help members understand costs and payment options.  

This position requires the ability to multitask and a solid understanding of dental terminology. This role requires participation in Saturday clinics, scheduled on a rotating basis, as designated by the Supervisor.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  

1\. Responsible for establishing and upholding a welcoming atmosphere while adhering to professional communication etiquette. Welcoming all members in a polite, supportive and professional manner both over the phone and in person.  

2\. Distribute, gather and scan the updated annual required forms, following the established workflows for completing and scanning both mini and annual registrations into the EHR system for all members. (i.e. registration forms, departmental policy and acknowledgement forms).  

3\. Adhere to telephone management protocols by responding to phone calls by the third ring, reviewing voicemails every two hours, and returning calls within 24 hours.  

4\. Oversee, evaluate, and reply to all incoming communications, including messages, emails and faxes. Receive and forward messages to relevant recipients (i.e. providers, manager).  

5\. Responsible for implementing and accurately following scheduling practices and workflows. Actively managing and “tetrising” appointments to enhance appointment capacity and to occupy all appointment gaps.  

6\. Execute all responsibilities associated with the robust confirmation call workflows, ensuring that all aspects of the workflow are completed effectively and accurately.  

7\. Oversee, sustain, and update various treatment\-specific waitlists daily.  

8\. Conduct thorough in\-reach calls for recall appointments, targeted populations and scheduling upon release of schedules.  

9\. Responsible for collecting co\-payments, coinsurance, informing members of account balances and providing payment receipts to members. Transactions are to be posted into the member’s record immediately and accurately. This task is crucial to maintaining the financial health of the dental department.  

10\. Responsible for reconciling daily cash collections and cash drawer.  

11\. Respond to member inquiries regarding their treatment plan. Occasionally, provide information about financial responsibilities, insurance, benefits, account status, if requested when Member Services is unavailable.  

12\. Arrange for collection and delivery of dental lab cases, ensuring to keep an up\-to\-date record of pick\-ups and deliveries by obtaining signatures from laboratory staff.  

13\. Ensure that the eligibility of member insurance has been verified for all scheduled appointments at least two days in advance. Additionally, inform members promptly about any changes to their insurance coverage.  

14\. Ensure that members are checked in for their scheduled appointments promptly and complete all dental workflows related to the member’s appointment, including printing of all labels for forms.  

15\. Create and review alerts and flags for member accounts regarding account status, identification of qualifying programs, service locations, treatment related notes, member transfer of care status, etc.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**Hi! We're Forerunner.**
=========================


Stronger, more resilient communities are built by the people inside government and regulated industries who keep critical infrastructure running. But they're working against real headwinds: fragmented data, field crews without the right tools, and high\-stakes decisions made without a complete picture.


Forerunner exists to fix that. We build intelligent software that connects the systems these agencies and firms already rely on, fills the gaps those systems can't, and turns fragmented information into decisions and actions that reduce liability, surface revenue, and prevent small problems from becoming emergencies.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Success Manager, you will own the ongoing success of a full book of business — from onboarding through renewal — ensuring every account realizes measurable value from Forerunner and grows into a durable, trusted partnership. You'll work at the intersection of relationship management, product adoption, and account growth, partnering with Sales, Product, and Engineering to keep outcomes on track.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Customer Health \& Retention**

* Serve as a trusted advisor to your accounts, understanding their workflows and goals well enough to guide them toward renewal.
* Own customer health across your portfolio, using data and regular check\-ins to catch risk early and keep accounts moving toward measurable outcomes.
* Guide customers through public\-sector and regulated\-industry decision cycles with patience and clear communication.

### **Product Adoption**

* Partner with the Deployment Specialist to take a clean handoff at go\-live and carry momentum into the ongoing success phase.
* Drive adoption through user communications, customized in\-app onboarding, and continued learning so customers get full value from their investment.
* Configure customer environments and settings as needs evolve, using both the product front end and Forerunner's internal tools.

### **Account Growth**

* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities — upsells, add\-ons, and cross\-sells — within your accounts.
* Partner with Sales and leadership to build the case for expansion and drive it to close.

### **Cross\-Functional Partnership**

* Share customer feedback, ideas, and concerns with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
* Evangelize customer success stories across your accounts to help build the broader Forerunner community.

### **Team Building**

* Contribute to the ongoing development of CS policy, process, and playbooks as an early member of a growing team.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4\-6 years of professional experience in customer success, account management, or client services, with a track record of managing end\-to\-end renewals and proactively uncovering expansion opportunities within a portfolio.
* Experience serving government agencies or regulated industries — GovTech, floodplain management or flood insurance, GIS/mapping, or public\-sector project management are all relevant backgrounds, though not required.
* Comfortable managing complex, public\-sector relationships and decision cycles; experience partnering with government clients or supporting complex public\-sector workflows is a plus.
* An excellent, empathetic communicator — you're often a customer's first point of contact, and building trust matters in our space.
* Detail\-oriented and committed to quality, with genuine enthusiasm for creating customer value.
* Comfortable with a high degree of ambiguity — able to prioritize independently and take on responsibility as the team grows.
* Experience supporting SaaS software is preferred but not required.

**You'll thrive in this role if you...**
----------------------------------------

* Believe in delivering measurable outcomes to customers, not just checking off tasks.
* Enjoy being a trusted point of contact and building long\-term relationships.
* Are comfortable balancing day\-to\-day account management with longer\-term account strategy.

**Our team has a lot to offer.**
--------------------------------


Forerunner is an early\-stage company with an interdisciplinary team. We are motivated by seemingly intractable problems and work hard to support one another.

* **We're mission\-driven.** Our mission orients our business strategy and pushes us to work with a sense of urgency. We're in the weeds — our entire team spends time engaging with our partners in the field to better understand the real\-world problems they face.
* **We're a small team.** As a member of our growing team, you will quickly become an invaluable part of our organization and have a meaningful impact on our business and technical direction. We welcome unique perspectives and backgrounds. Your opinion matters and we hope you'll share it.
* **We build each other up.** A team works best when its members are equipped with the tools to tackle the problems they're facing. Forerunner strives to provide meaningful feedback and learning opportunities to help all our team members grow.
* **We value in\-person connection**, so we keep offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Portland, ME. Roles can be hybrid or fully remote, depending on the work.
* **We want you to be happy and healthy.** Forerunner offers competitive compensation, health/vision/dental coverage, a 401k plan, and one expensed lunch per week. We also have a quarterly wellness reimbursement so you can define what "health" means to you.
* **The salary range for this position** is $90,000\-$120,000 with an OTE of $105,000\-$135,000\. This posting may span more than one career level. Compensation is determined based on a variety of factors, including an individual's skills, experience, and qualifications.


Forerunner is an equal opportunity employer committed to embracing diversity and the perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds.

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence\-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer\-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer\-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life\-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI\-powered platform combining the highest\-quality care and technology solutions.

Lyra Health is looking for a high\-impact Operations Lead to execute the operations for our Neurodiversity Center of Excellence (COE). This is a critical role designed for a strategic operator who thrives at the intersection of process design, clinical collaboration, and innovation. jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***


We are hiring a Quality Assurance Manager to support the QA function within Devoted’s Risk Adjustment organization. This person owns the quality assurance program for our retrospective coding and auditing operations: the policies and SOPs behind it, the team that runs it, and the findings it produces. You will direct the work of a team of QA Reviewers, own the QA relationship with internal operational leaders and vendor partners (including AHS off\-shore coding teams), review escalated charts yourself or facilitate further escalation, and turn findings into education and process changes that raise coding accuracy across the department. You will also inform how technology is used to assist this work in accordance with our acceptable use policy.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* Serve as an expert on ICD\-10\-CM coding guidelines, AHA Coding Clinic guidance, and internal risk adjustment guidance
* Oversee an offshore FDR vendor team of QA Reviewers: set accuracy and productivity standards, review performance against them, and adjust volume allocation based on results
* Escalate staffing, training, and quality gaps to vendor management, which owns hiring, onboarding, and day\-to\-day supervision
* Own and maintain Devoted’s QA policies and SOPs for coding quality, retrospective coding, and audit operations (operational and subject matter owner; subject matter owner for the others)
* Plan QA review coverage and sampling across internal staff and vendors, including AHS off\-shore coding teams, so that samples are representative and review volumes are met
* Perform QA reviews of escalated, disputed, and high\-risk charts, and serving as the internal authority on coding disagreements the team cannot resolve; ensuring diagnoses selected for review are appropriate, accurate, and supported by clinical documentation
* Own the monthly and quarterly QA Scorecard process: accuracy of the findings, delivery to Risk Adjustment leadership, coders, and vendor leaders during meetings, and follow\-through on remediation plans
* Identify documentation and coding trends across reviewers and vendors, present them to department leadership, and convert them into education, job aids, or process changes
* Run the review of individual QA work so the QA team’s own accuracy is measured, and incorporating material findings into the QA process going forward
* Partner with vendor leadership on quality expectations, corrective action, and escalation when performance does not meet standard
* Own timely resolution of coding questions from sources coding on behalf of Devoted, and maintaining the log of questions and answers as outlined by policy or procedure
* Partner with technology and analytics teams on risk adjustment tooling, including AI\-assisted coding: define QA requirements, test releases and enhancements, and provide feedback on design and performance, within acceptable use policies
* Build and run monitoring for tools in production, tracking performance drift and error patterns concentrated in specific conditions, chart types, providers, or member populations
* Support retrospective coding and audits by abstracting medical records or ICD\-10 codes for submission to CMS when volume or complexity requires it
* Recommend process improvements and preparing department reporting so productivity and quality goals are met or exceeded and operational efficiency is optimized
* Serving as a voting risk adjustment coding SME member on Devoted’s Coding Steering Workgroup
* Act in an ethical manner as required under HIPAA’s Privacy and Security rules, handling patient data with uncompromised adherence to the law, including what member data may be sent to which vendor systems
* Perform other related duties as required

***Required skills and experience:***

* Current relevant coding certification recognized by AAPC or AHIMA. Examples of relevant certifications include: CPC, CRC, CCS, CCS\-P
* 7\+ years of recent and related experience in medical record documentation review, diagnosis coding, and/or auditing, including risk adjustment coding
* Experience leading development and presentation of accuracy or performance results to production coders or management
* Sound knowledge of ICD\-10\-CM coding guidelines and regulations to meet regulatory, compliance, and internal policy requirements, and the ability to read medical records and abstract clinical diagnosis codes from documentation

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Expertise in CMS risk adjustment models
* Experience managing or overseeing vendor and/or off\-shore coding teams
* Experience validating or auditing AI\-assisted, NLP, or computer\-assisted coding (CAC) tools, or other automated chart review technology
* Experience writing or substantially revising QA policies, SOPs, or audit sampling methodology
* Communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, including formatting and presenting QA Review results and delivering findings to staff and vendor leaders

**We are seeking a Care Coordination Supervisor!**


**Ross County, OH**  

  

***This role is eligible for a $5,000 hiring bonus!***


Join our team!


Integrated Services for Behavioral Health (ISBH) is a community\-minded, forward\-thinking behavioral health organization helping people along the road to health and well\-being. We meet people in their homes and communities and help connect them to the resources they need. We serve Southeastern and Central Ohio with a comprehensive array of behavioral health and other services – working with local partners to promote healthy people and strong communities. All of our services are intended to be collaborative and personalized for the individual.


The Care Coordination Supervisor is primarily responsible for ensuring adherence to the high\-fidelity wraparound model of care coordination, ensuring quality care for children and families/caregivers representing diverse socioeconomic, racial, ethnic, and cultural backgrounds. The supervisor has a thorough understanding of local community resources and is skilled at developing and maintaining working relationships with staff, clients, and community partners.


***The salary range for this position is*** ***$52,609\.67 – $63,282\.33*** ***based on experience, education, and/or licensure:***

* Provide routine training, support, and assistance to staff through individual and group conferences, assistance in analyzing case problems, and in improving their skills.

* Assures documentation meets Medicaid standards.
* Evaluates the performance of staff members and recommends appropriate action to the manager.
* Participate in the review and selection of new staff, including but not limited to completion of position requisitions, applicant reviews, and interviews.

* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in social work, education, counseling, psychology, or another related field preferred.
* LSW/LPC preferred.
* Three years of experience providing coordinated supportive services/care coordination services.
* Previous supervisory experience strongly preferred.
* Experience working in the behavioral health field required, preferably experience working with multi\-system youth, or individuals with autism and/or developmental disabilities.
* Working knowledge of local, state, and federal regulations for services for behavioral health, developmental disabilities, and autism.
* Knowledge of high\-fidelity wraparound services preferred (training provided post\-hire).
* Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, demonstrating professionalism with children, youth, families/caregivers, colleagues, and partners.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to stay focused
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks
* Demonstrated clinical knowledge of children with co\-occurring developmental disorders and complex behavioral health issues

* Ability to operate, receive and conduct video calls and/or meetings in an automated office environment is required
* Ability to maintain a minimum of 100mbps for high\-speed internet connection is required

* Medical
* Dental
* Vision
* Short\-term Disability
* Long\-term Disability
* 401K w/ Employer Match
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) provides support and resources to help you and your family with a range of issues.

Delivering exceptional care through connection

jobs.title: Strategy and Operations Manager, TikTok Shop
jobs.description:
**Job description**

**About Boost Engine**

Boost Engine is a tech\-led company redefining global brand growth through AI. Founded in 2024, we've quickly become a leading growth partner for TikTok Shop in the US market — surpassing tens of millions of dollars in monthly GMV, named TikTok's **Top Annual Ecosystem Partner** (one of only 5 worldwide), and recognized on **Forbes' Startups 100 list**.

We don't just use AI — we build it. Our proprietary systems, **OperaX** and **AutoBoost**, apply AI agents across market research, business analysis, strategy design, performance monitoring, data processing, and operational execution, helping global brands drive over $20M in monthly GMV growth.

Humans define the vision, make the business calls, and own the results. Agents unlock the productivity to get there. We're looking for growth talent who want to work alongside AI — using it to handle research, analysis, and monitoring, so you can focus on judgment, communication, and decisions that move the business. Join us as we push AI from answering questions to getting work done.

AI beyond "answering questions" toward "getting work done and delivering results."

**The Role**

You'll work on real business problems for US consumer brands — researching how brands grow, how they enter social commerce, and how they connect content, creators, distribution, and transactions — then turn that analysis into compelling business proposals, and executable plans.

This isn't a traditional e\-commerce operations role, and it isn't a pure proposal\-writing role either. We don't require prior experience with TikTok Shop, social commerce, or creator marketing — that's not the filter we're using. What matters more than industry vocabulary is whether you can get back to first principles on an unfamiliar business, quickly identify the variables that actually drive growth, profit, competition, and resource allocation, form an independent and well\-reasoned judgment, and use AI to go deeper and turn your method into something reusable.

**What You'll Do**

* Research and analyze — study US consumer brands, industry trends, consumers, competitive landscape, and business models; turn ambiguous client asks into clear problem definitions, hypotheses, and analysis plans; get to the core drivers of revenue, margin, and competitive position fast, even in an industry you've never worked in; separate fact from assumption and verify the data behind any claim
* Design brand growth and social commerce strategy — analyze how brands connect brand, product, content, creator, distribution, and transaction; study how brands grow from awareness to purchase to repeat in social commerce; diagnose bottlenecks across product, content, channels, and execution; turn judgment into a growth strategy with clear KPIs and risk boundaries, balancing short\-term sales against long\-term brand building
* Produce English proposals and business materials — independently or collaboratively build BD proposals, pitch decks, business cases, market entry plans, growth strategies, campaign plans, and JBPs; connect client goals, market evidence, and our capabilities into one coherent narrative; iterate quickly with the US BD, Strategy, and Operations teams based on feedback; own the logic, data integrity, and quality of what you deliver
* Build AI skills, agents, and workflows — use "vibe coding" to turn your own research and analysis methods into working tools: prompts, templates, knowledge bases, skills, or agents the team can reuse; break frequent tasks into clear inputs, process, outputs, and human checkpoints; test new models and tools and decide what's worth keeping based on real results
* Own the quality of AI output — never take AI\-generated content as the final answer; verify research, data, and conclusions; decide what AI should own versus what needs your judgment; catch hallucinations, gaps, or unverified claims before they reach a client

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent structured thinking and business analysis — able to break down a complex, ambiguous problem into a clear framework
* Able to get up to speed fast in an unfamiliar industry — build a point of view, find evidence, and test hypotheses without relying on existing playbooks
* Sharp on business fundamentals: revenue, margin, customer needs, competitive advantage, resource allocation
* Excellent written and spoken English — able to independently produce professional, client\-ready materials
* Independent judgment — doesn't default to convention, and doesn't take AI output at face value either
* High self\-direction — moves forward on incomplete information instead of waiting for instructions
* Genuine, ongoing interest in applying AI — not just using it to write faster, but actively testing new models, agents, and automation tools
* Real "vibe coding" experience — you can point to at least one AI skill, agent, or automated workflow you've actually built and used
* No computer science or traditional engineering background required, but a real builder mentality is

*Note: TikTok Shop, social commerce, and creator marketing experience are explicitly not required for this role — we're optimizing for how fast you can get past "I haven't done this before" and arrive at a better answer than someone who has.*

**Nice to Have**

* Background in management or strategy consulting, corporate strategy/corporate development, investment or industry research, market entry or growth strategy, or strategy/BizOps/special projects at a high\-quality startup
* English\-language proposals, pitch decks, investment memos, or strategy work you can share
* Experience working through a real, complex, information\-incomplete business problem
* Familiarity with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Replit, Lovable, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools
* Hands\-on experience with agents, RAG, API workflows, or internal data/business tooling
* Experience with US consumer brands, cross\-border business, DTC, marketing, or growt

jobs.title: HR & People Operations Manager

Avani Services is a growing small business supporting federal agencies through human capital, leadership development, training, program management, and performance improvement services. Our work is delivered by a nationwide team of employees, consultants, and subject\-matter experts.

As Avani continues to grow, we are looking for an organized, resourceful HR \& People Operations Manager to own the systems and processes that support our team. This person will make sure routine HR matters are handled accurately, consistently, and responsively.

**The Role**

The HR \& People Operations Manager will oversee Avani’s day\-to\-day people operations across the employee lifecycle, from offer letter through offboarding. This is a hands\-on role for someone comfortable moving between employee support, HR systems, documentation, benefits, compliance, recruiting administration, and process improvement.

We are open to full\-time or part\-time candidates, approximately 15–40 hours per week, depending on experience, availability, and mutual fit. This is a remote position, preferably for someone working on Central or Eastern Time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare offer letters, employment agreements, promotion letters, compensation\-change notices, independent contractor agreements, and other personnel documents.
* Coordinate onboarding and offboarding for employees and independent contractors.

jobs.description:
**Company:** VidTech  
**Location:** Remote, United States  
**Type:** 1099 Independent Contractor \| Per\-Project

**About VidTech**

VidTech is a Commercial Real Estate media and technology company producing video, drone, photography, 3D, virtual tour, and other digital media for commercial real estate professionals.

We're a fully remote team that combines innovative technology with a strong belief in exceptional, personal customer service.

This is **not a traditional Project Manager role** centered around project plans, reporting, and internal meetings.

At VidTech, our Project Managers are the **face and owner of the client's project**.

You'll communicate directly with clients, coordinate drone pilots, photographers, videographers, editors, and internal teammates, keep projects organized, and solve problems when things don't go according to plan.

The most important skills for this role are:

* **Exceptional communication**
* **Organization and follow\-through**
* **Coordination**
* **Problem\-solving**
* **Flexibility**
* **Ownership**

You do **not** need extensive technology, commercial real estate, or media production experience. You also don't need to already know tools like HubSpot, Asana, or Vimeo.

Those things can be taught.

What matters most is your ability to work confidently with clients, keep multiple moving pieces organized, communicate clearly with different people, adapt when circumstances change, and find solutions.

**What You'll Do**

For your assigned projects, you'll:

* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client
* Understand the client's goals, requirements, and expectations
* Coordinate project schedules, deadlines, and next steps
* Source and coordinate drone pilots, photographers, and videographers when needed
* Coordinate property access and capture requirements
* Communicate project instructions to operators, editors, and internal teammates
* Act as the liaison between clients and our production team
* Translate client feedback into clear revision instructions
* Proactively communicate updates, delays, or changes
* Identify missing information and potential problems before they create delays
* Solve scheduling, production, and client\-service issues
* Manage multiple active projects while keeping information accurate and organized
* Guide projects through final client approval and completion

**Who We're Looking For**

You may be a great fit if you:

* Genuinely enjoy communicating with clients
* Write and speak clearly, professionally, and confidently
* Are highly organized and dependable
* Naturally keep track of details, commitments, and next steps
* Can coordinate multiple people and priorities at once
* Stay composed when something goes wrong
* Look for solutions instead of simply identifying problems
* Are comfortable making decisions without constant direction
* Can adapt when schedules, priorities, or circumstances change
* Take ownership and follow through
* Are comfortable learning new processes and technology

Experience in Client Success, customer service, account management, project coordination, project management, production, operations, or similar client\-facing work is helpful.

Experience with commercial real estate, video, photography, drones, creative production, Asana, HubSpot, Vimeo, or similar platforms is a **plus — not a requirement**.

**Compensation \& Project Volume**

This is a **1099 independent contractor position paid on a per\-project basis**.

**Per\-project compensation ranges from approximately $45–$250**, depending on the type and complexity of the project.

Project scope and duration can vary significantly. Some projects may involve only photography or video capture and can be completed within a few days. More complex projects involving fully edited videos, 3D models, virtual tours, or multiple production components may remain active for several weeks.

Project volume also varies based on company demand, project mix, your availability, and performance. A Project Manager may typically oversee approximately **25–45 active projects at a time**, depending on complexity, while more experienced PMs may be able to manage a higher volume.

Because compensation is tied to the projects you manage, there is meaningful opportunity to **increase your earnings by taking on additional project volume as you become more experienced and demonstrate strong performance**.

Strong performers may also have opportunities to take on greater responsibility and grow with VidTech over time.

**Why VidTech?**

* Fully remote work
* Flexible per\-project workload
* Ability to grow your project volume and earning potential
* Meaningful ownership of your projects and client relationships
* Work across video, photography, drones, 3D, and commercial real estate
* Collaborate with creative and technical professionals across the country and around the world
* Learn new production systems and technologies
* Opportunity for additional responsibility as VidTech grows

**Before You Apply**

You do not need to be a career Project Manager.

You **do** need to be an excellent communicator, organized, dependable, flexible, solutions\-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership when several people are depending on you.

If you enjoy working with clients **and** you're good at keeping people, information, and deadlines organized behind the scenes, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $20,000\.00 \- $45,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

We are building a FOIA team to support a federal health agency and are looking for career FOIA practitioners who want their judgment to carry weight.

* Experience with FOIA case management systems such as FOIAXpress and with eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity.
* Strong written communication, including reports, correspondence, and leadership briefings.

As AI Program Manager, you will take SmartTech.ai from siloed experimentation to a governed, supported, and scalable capability — setting light\-touch policy and standards, standing up the development frameworks and hosting platforms that turn prototypes into deployable products, pairing the right tools to the right use cases, and raising the AI fluency of every employee through training, messaging, and hands\-on support.

  

This is STC's first dedicated AI enablement hire. You will report to the VP of Engineering \& Technology, operate within the SPI department, and coordinate a hub\-and\-spoke network of departmental AI Champions. You are equal parts builder and enabler — technical enough to architect and ship AI solutions yourself, and skilled enough with people and process to make the entire company better at using AI. You will receive general direction on objectives and work independently to build the program, communicating and operating in line with organizational goals and values as well as departmental objectives.

 **Program Governance, Policy \& Intake (20%)**

* Establish light\-touch, practical governance for AI use company\-wide — acceptable\-use standards, data\-handling and security guardrails, and a clear tool\-approval pathway — in partnership with IT and InfoSec

* Raise the AI fluency of the entire company — technical and non\-technical staff alike — through hands\-on training, office hours, documentation, and reusable prompt and workflow libraries
* Own internal messaging and change management for SmartTech.ai: announcements, wins, and adoption campaigns that build momentum and engagement
* Coordinate the departmental AI Champions network, turning individual wins into shared, company\-wide capability

 **Solution Development \& Deployment (20%)**

* Turn ideas and prototypes into deployable, supportable solutions — designing, building, and shipping LLM\-powered tools, agents, and integrations
* Serve as a hands\-on power user of Claude and modern AI development tools, setting the technical bar for prompt engineering, agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) over company knowledge, and API integration
* Harden and deploy high\-value prototypes built by others so delivery teams can rely on them without owning their maintenance

 **Development Frameworks \& Hosting Platforms (15%)**

* Design and stand up the sanctioned development environments, hosting platforms, and DevOps toolchain (source control, CI/CD, containerization, cloud hosting) that let AI solutions be built, deployed, and maintained safely and repeatably
* Replace ad\-hoc, unsanctioned workarounds with secure, documented, scalable infrastructure, in coordination with IT and InfoSec
* Establish reusable patterns, templates, and reference architectures for AI application development

 **Tool \& Use\-Case Portfolio Management (15%)**

* Evaluate, select, and manage the company's portfolio of AI tools and platforms; map tools to specific business needs and use cases so teams adopt the right tool for the job
* Track adoption, value, and ROI; maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI investments aligned to corporate growth targets
* Manage vendor relationships, licensing, and cost, and advise leadership on build\-vs\-buy decisions

* Leverage AI\-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high\-quality work output
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance
* Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Contractor)
jobs.description:
Condor Health is seeking an experienced independent professional to serve as a Technical Account Manager (TAM) supporting customers using our SaaS solutions. This role combines customer success, technical account management, analytical problem\-solving, project coordination, product demonstration, and consultative account growth.

**Overview**

The Technical Account Manager serves as the primary relationship and operational point of contact for an assigned portfolio of customers. The TAM is responsible for understanding each customer's use of our solutions, proactively managing service needs, coordinating customer requests and issues, and helping customers successfully use their contracted products and services.

Our customers represent a range of roles and technical backgrounds. The TAM therefore serves as an important bridge between customers and our Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, Project, and Support teams. The TAM must be able to understand product functionality and technical concepts well enough to translate them into clear, practical language for customers, while also accurately communicating customer workflows, needs, and concerns to internal teams.

*The TAM needs enough product and software\-development literacy to recognize what kind of work is needed, get the right people involved, and help shepherd that work through the customer relationship.*

The TAM is not expected to function as a software engineer or Business Analyst. For change orders and other development work, the TAM partners with Business Analysts and technical resources who lead detailed discovery, requirements, and solution definition. The TAM remains the customer\-facing owner and provides project\-management\-style coordination during execution, helping maintain communication, track decisions and actions, surface risks or blockers, and support timely completion.

The role also includes a consultative account\-growth component. TAMs are expected to understand customer needs, identify opportunities where additional products or services may provide value, demonstrate relevant capabilities, and support appropriate account expansion. This is not a quota\- or commission\-based sales role.

* Proactively manage customer service needs and account priorities to support customer satisfaction, retention, adoption, and successful use of contracted solutions.
* Prepare for and facilitate recurring customer account\-management meetings; develop agendas, review open items, guide discussion, document decisions and action items, and ensure timely follow\-through.
* Investigate and triage customer questions and requests, identify missing information, determine appropriate next steps, and engage the correct internal resources rather than simply routing questions between teams.

* Act as a liaison among customers, internal teams, and vendors when coordination is required.
* Identify and document opportunities to improve account\-management and customer\-facing processes when within contracted scope.
* Perform services in accordance with agreed project procedures and applicable security and confidentiality requirements.

### **About the role**


Bettercomp is looking for a hands\-on, technically strong **Manager, Customer Support** to lead our Customer Support team — the group that delivers responsive, high\-quality support across product questions, access, and issue resolution for our customers. You'll build the structure that lets this team scale: clear tiering and escalation paths, strong coaching, and Bettercomp's first AI\-assisted support layer. You'll also take the reins on a few high\-visibility areas — our Help Center, release communications, and in\-app guidance — that are core to how customers experience Bettercomp. You'll partner closely with the VP of Customer Success, Data Operations, and Product \& Engineering to make Support a genuine strength of the customer experience.

### **What you'll do:**

 **Lead and grow the team*** Build a skill\-tier system (L1/L2\) with clean, documented escalation paths, so the right issue reaches the right person quickly and consistently.
* Own coaching, development, and performance management for the Support team, with a steady cadence of 1:1s and clear growth paths.
* Design onboarding and ongoing assessment and training so the whole team builds deep product expertise, not just a few go\-to specialists.

 **Run a great support operation*** Own Support's SLAs, ticket quality, and customer satisfaction outcomes, with clear service tiers matched to ticket complexity.
* Define a clean, repeatable model for high\-touch engagements, including what a great start and finish look like.
* Make Support's performance data (response time, backlog, CSAT) visible and useful to CS leadership on an ongoing basis.
* Own our Help Center and release communications — turning product updates into clear, well\-organized customer\-facing content — and keep our in\-app guidance current.
* Maintain the team's internal AI\-assisted reply\-drafting tool, evolving it as the team's needs grow.

 **Drive automation and cross\-functional partnership*** Lead the build of Bettercomp's first AI\-assisted support triage and first\-response layer — a flagship opportunity to raise the bar on speed and consistency as we scale.
* Partner with in\-function CS teams (Implementation and Success) and cross\-functionally with Data Operations, Product, and Engineering so escalations move quickly and customers get consistent, well\-communicated outcomes.
* Bring Support's perspective into company\-wide data and process decisions that affect the customer experience.

### **What you bring:**

* 5\+ years in customer support, technical support, or service delivery in B2B SaaS, with 2\+ years directly managing a team.
* A strong technical foundation — comfort with data pipelines, integrations, or platform troubleshooting, since our product involves real data complexity.
* A track record of building support structure — tiering, escalation design, QA — and of bringing a team along through change with confidence and clarity.
* Experience shipping AI\-assisted or automated support tooling; this is a flagship priority for the role.
* Comfort owning customer\-facing content — help center articles, release notes, in\-app guidance.
* Working knowledge of a ticketing platform (Zendesk or equivalent) and a data\-driven approach to SLAs and quality.
* Strong written communication.
* HR tech, compensation, or another data\-rich B2B SaaS background is a plus, as is familiarity building or maintaining AI/Claude\-based tools.

### **First 90 days — what success looks like:**

* Strong working relationships established across the team, anchored by a clear plan with Joe on his role and growth path going forward.
* A documented, published escalation path the whole team (and in\-function CS partners) knows and trusts.
* A skill\-tier framework in place with a clear plan to develop the team's newer members.
* Clear ownership established for Help Center, release communications, in\-app guidance, and the team's reply\-drafting tool.
* A concrete plan for an AI\-assisted first\-response layer, with a first version shipped or in motion.
* Support's performance dashboard in active use by CS leadership.

### **Why you’ll love it:**


Bettercomp is transforming the way companies approach compensation, delivering modern, data\-driven solutions that help organizations streamline pay practices, ensure fairness, and stay competitive. With a growing roster of enterprise clients, including many of the world’s largest companies, we’re redefining how compensation teams work.

  

As a fast\-moving startup, we thrive on building what doesn’t yet exist—solving complex problems with creativity, agility, and a bias for action. At Bettercomp, you’ll be part of a forward\-thinking team that values bold ideas, empowers you to take ownership, and provides the support needed to grow your career.

  

Our success is driven by exceptional people. We hire top talent and give them the autonomy and space to do their best work. Here, you’ll collaborate with some of the most innovative and driven minds in the industry, tackling compensation’s toughest challenges and shaping the future of HRTech.

### **What we offer:**

* Our fully remote position, based in the U.S., offers you the freedom to work from the comfort of your home, giving you the flexibility you've always wanted.
* Competitive compensation package that includes:
* + Base salary range for this position: **$104,000 — $124,000** (annually based on experience and location)
	+ Equity
* Flexible PTO, generous company holidays
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match

 *In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States.*

jobs.description:
**ABOUT KION**


Kion is revolutionizing CloudOps and FinOps. We offer a unified approach, delivering multicloud, multi\-org, and multi\-account visibility and controls, empowering organizations to effectively manage their complex cloud environments from a single, centralized platform. At Kion, you’ll join a team that values collaboration, creativity, and building products that make a real impact for customers across industries.


We’re a fast\-growing, Series A startup and we believe employees are our most precious resource. While we’re headquartered outside Baltimore, MD and Washington DC, we are committed to a 100% remote\-first workforce. In addition, Kion offers excellent compensation and outstanding benefits!


If you're passionate about using your expert skills to bring transformational change to a customer’s cloud journey, you'd be a great addition to our team!

 **ABOUT THE ROLE**


As a Technical Account Manager at Kion, you are the primary technical advisor and technical relationship owner for a dedicated portfolio of customers, partnering with the CSM (who orchestrates the account) and the AE (who owns the commercial motion). Your north star is Kion's core value: **Turning Customers into Fans**.


You will run structured, tiered engagement cadences, serve as the connective tissue between customers and Kion's Engineering, Product, and Support teams, and own the technical side of the customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal. Your customers will span enterprise commercial accounts (life sciences, tech, higher education) and government/defense accounts. Success looks like customers who renew, expand, and advocate for Kion because they trust your technical guidance and feel that you genuinely own their outcomes. You’ll also be joining at an exciting moment: the broader Customer Success team is refining how it works, so you can expect aspects of this role to keep evolving as those improvements take shape.

 **YOUR DAY\-TO\-DAY:**

* Own a named portfolio of 8–10 strategic (Tier 1–2\) accounts plus a pooled set of \~8 mid\-tier accounts (15–18 total), and serve as their primary point of contact for all platform and technical matters
* Lead onboarding for new accounts in your book to a 90\-day time\-to\-value standard — onboarding is the first renewal activity, not a support task
* Run tiered customer syncs: monthly technical check\-ins with strategic accounts, 6–8 week check\-ins with named growth accounts, and quarterly proactive outreach to the pooled book — with structured agendas sent ahead, notes, tracked action items, and a written recap within two business days
* Advise customers on platform upgrades: timing, release notes highlights, known issues, and coordinating phased rollouts from sandbox to non\-prod to production
* Troubleshoot and own customer platform issues end\-to\-end, including compliance dashboard configuration, spend reporting gaps, permissions, integrations, and enforcement policy behavior
* Guide customers on cloud governance and FinOps best practices: budget\-to\-actuals analysis, cost anomaly investigation, multi\-cloud spend visibility, and rightsizing guidance
* Drive adoption of new platform features and capabilities, including AI\-assisted tooling, through demos, working sessions, and proactive outreach
* Maintain accurate, current account health tracking in CRM within 48 hours of every meaningful interaction: open items, sentiment, risk flags, and next steps
* Host the weekly customer office\-hours rotation; answer customer questions within one business day (strategic accounts) or two (pooled book); act on health triggers — e.g., a \>30% usage decline — within one week
* Co\-present quarterly business reviews (Kion Objective Reviews / KORs) for strategic accounts with the CSM — owning the adoption story and roadmap segment — and deliver semi\-annual executive business reviews, annual health reviews, and quarterly written usage \& value reports for mid\-tier accounts
* Serve as the bridge between customers and Kion's Support team, ensuring tickets are scoped correctly, prioritized appropriately, and moving; escalating when they are not
* Represent customer bug reports and feature requests in internal cross\-functional reviews, with context on business impact and urgency
* Attend and contribute to internal rhythms: weekly CSM\+TAM standup, monthly Tier 1 account reviews (with CSM and AE), weekly TAM Sync, Support Team Sync, Bug and Feature Review, Sprint Demos, and monthly Product leadership syncs
* Partner with Account Executives on renewal cycles, expansion opportunities, and Professional Service SOWs
* Contribute to the Kion Success Center knowledge base when documentation gaps are identified based on recurring customer questions
* Engage customers in the Kion community Slack (Cloudunity) with release updates, answers, and discussions

 **HOW YOU'LL BE MEASURED:**

* Time\-to\-value: new accounts reach first measurable value inside 90 days
* Technical health score of your book, and health\-trigger response time
* On\-time delivery of prescribed touchpoints: check\-ins, EBRs, health reviews, and usage reports
* Critical\-issue resolution time and escalation quality
* Renewal outcomes on your book, in partnership with the AE — the adoption story you supply feeds every value recap

 **WHAT WE ARE EXPECTING FROM YOU (I.E., THE QUALIFICATIONS YOU MUST HAVE):**

* Relationship\-first mindset: you build genuine trust through consistent follow\-through, technical credibility, and treating customer problems as your own

jobs.title: Remote HR Generalist — Private Ambulance / NEMT Experience Required
jobs.description:
### **Read this first**


**This role requires prior work experience at a private ambulance, EMS or NEMT company.** Not "healthcare in general." Not hospital HR. We mean you have worked for an ambulance service or medical transportation provider and you already know how this business runs.



This position is fully remote, which means we cannot spend the first six months teaching someone the industry. You need to already understand crews, shifts, certifications, dispatch, payors and facility partners on day one. **Applications without private ambulance, EMS or NEMT employment history will not be considered.**



If that's you, keep reading — this is a great remote seat with real ownership.


### **About Priority Patient Transport**



Priority Patient Transport has served Virginia's Shenandoah Valley and Central Virginia since 2007\. From five offices — Staunton (HQ), Harrisonburg, Charlottesville, Winchester and Roanoke — our teams provide non\-emergency medical transportation (wheelchair, BLS and ALS), community paramedicine and mobile integrated healthcare visits, EMS standby for events, and transport services under federal and state contracts.



Our people are the company. EMTs, paramedics, wheelchair van operators and dispatchers are who our patients and facility partners actually see — and keeping those crews hired, credentialed and supported is what this role is about.


### **The role**



We're hiring a fully remote Human Resources Generalist to run day\-to\-day HR for our multi\-site EMS organization: recruiting and hiring field staff, onboarding, EMS credential tracking, benefits and leave paperwork, and being the person employees call with questions.



You'll work from your own office, partner by phone, video and messaging with our operations managers and field supervisors at all five locations, and report directly to the owner/VP of Operations. The daily work is yours to run; the bigger calls — policy changes, terminations, serious employee\-relations matters — come to leadership.



Because you already come from this industry, you'll recognize the problems on sight: the medic whose Virginia OEMS cert lapses in 60 days, the open night car nobody wants, the wheelchair van driver whose MVR just came back wrong, the new hire who ghosted before orientation.


### **What you'll do**


**Recruiting and hiring**


* Post and manage openings for EMTs, paramedics, wheelchair van operators, dispatchers and office staff; source candidates and run phone screens
* Coordinate interviews with on\-site operations leaders, keep candidates warm, and move offers and paperwork through fast — this industry loses candidates to slow hiring
* Build pipeline through EMT and paramedic programs, community colleges, fire/EMS agencies, virtual career fairs and employee referrals
* Keep the applicant tracking workflow current and report open positions and time\-to\-hire


**Onboarding and credentialing**


* Run new\-hire onboarding remotely: offer letters, e\-signature paperwork, background checks and fingerprinting, drug screening and DOT/physical scheduling, orientation setup
* Coordinate I\-9 completion with an authorized representative at the local office and verify documentation properly
* Hand off field training and preceptor assignment to operations and track completion
* Track every credential with zero lapses: Virginia OEMS / NREMT certifications, CPR, ACLS, PALS and other cards, driver's licenses and MVR checks, immunization and TB records, continuing education hours and recertification deadlines
* Own the recert and expiration calendar and push advance reminders to staff and supervisors


**Employee support and retention**


* Be reachable and responsive to employee questions from every location — phone, text, email and video, including crews on off\-shifts
* Document performance conversations and corrective action alongside supervisors, and escalate serious matters to leadership
* Conduct exit interviews, track turnover by office and position, and flag retention problems early
* Support recognition and engagement efforts for field staff who rarely sit at a desk


**Benefits, leave and payroll support**


* Handle benefit enrollments, changes and open enrollment, and answer employee benefit questions
* Process leave paperwork — FMLA, ADA accommodation requests, personal and medical leave, return\-to\-work — with leadership's sign\-off
* Provide payroll with accurate new hire, change, termination, PTO and shift\-differential information
* Report workplace injuries, open and follow workers' compensation claims, and track return\-to\-work status


**Records and compliance**


* Maintain personnel files and HR records accurately, confidentially and digitally
* Keep OSHA 300 logs, bloodborne pathogen and exposure documentation, and HIPAA training records current
* Follow and help maintain our handbook, job descriptions and HR policies
* Support documentation and personnel requirements tied to our federal and state contracts
* Send leadership clean weekly HR reporting: headcount, turnover, open positions, credential status

### **Required**


* **2\+ years of employment at a private ambulance company, EMS agency or NEMT / medical transportation provider — this is a hard requirement**
* 2\+ years of HR experience covering recruiting, onboarding and employee paperwork (may overlap with the above)
* Working knowledge of EMS credentialing: state EMS office certifications, NREMT, CPR/ACLS/PALS, MVR and driver requirements, recert cycles
* Familiarity with I\-9, FMLA, ADA and EEO basics — enough to know when to raise a flag
* Proven remote\-work track record: self\-managed, highly responsive, disciplined about documentation and follow\-through without anyone standing over you
* A private, secure home office, reliable high\-speed internet, and a setup where confidential employee and patient\-related information cannot be seen or overheard
* Comfortable living in phone, video and chat all day with people

jobs.title: Closing Receptionist / Evening Operations Coordinator (Seasonal)
jobs.description:
**Employer:** Valley Christmas Lights

**Type:** W\-2, Full\-Time (40 hrs/week), fully remote\- **must be based in the United States** **Schedule:** Tuesday–Saturday, 11:30 AM – 8:00 PM **Arizona time**

**Start:** September 23rd\- trained and running solo before the October install season opens

Mission

Be the customer's last call of the day and the crew's first advantage tomorrow.

You run the afternoon and evening phones, send quotes to homeowners who reach out after hours, and answer every customer question that lands while the office is quiet. Then, before you log off, you close the day: every job on tomorrow's board is briefed and correct, every dollar billable today is collected, every time card is punched out and accurate, and every crew walks into tomorrow morning knowing exactly what they're doing and what they need. Nothing rolls into tomorrow half\-done.

Outcomes (what "great" looks like)

* No call goes unanswered during your coverage window, and no evening voicemail sits overnight.
* Quotes go out the same hour they're requested, not the next morning.
* Every job on the next day's schedule has a complete, accurate brief before you log off\- address, scope, access details, materials, crew assignment\- confirmed with the customer.
* Daily billing is collected and reconciled at close.
* Every time card for the day is punched out and correct, with any correction documented and confirmed.
* Crew leads start each morning without a single question that could have been answered the night before.
* Leadership can look at the next day's board at 8:05 PM and trust it completely.

Core Responsibilities1\. Phones \& Customer Service (Primary, all shift)

You are the front line for the entire afternoon and evening.

* **Live answering.** Pick up inbound calls within 3 rings during your coverage window. When you can't, return the voicemail or text within 3 minutes. Warm, calm, professional tone\- many of these callers are choosing between us and two competitors on the same afternoon.
* **Lead qualification \& booking.** Ask structured questions to determine service type (seasonal vs. permanent lighting), property type (roof height, size, features), and timeline. Book quotes and installs directly with accurate details.
* **Customer questions, all of them.** Pricing, scheduling, what's included, what happens if a strand goes out in December, when takedown happens, where the deposit went. You are the answer, not the router!
* **Service issues.** If a customer reports a problem, schedule a fix for the next day.
* **CRM hygiene.** Every call, text, and email logged. Every status current. Nothing from a personal phone or personal email, ever.

2\. Remote Quoting

* Take address and square footage from inbound leads and produce a priced quote with a visual mockup using our quoting tool.
* Send it by email and text with a clear next step.
* Follow up on your own quotes through our defined cadence until the customer books or declines.
* **You own the after\-hours window.** Our daytime quoting team is off at 5:00 PM Arizona. From 5:00 to 8:00, which is when a lot of homeowners actually sit down and fill out forms, the quote either goes out from you or it doesn't go out.

3\. The Day\-Close

**Tomorrow's briefs.**

* Pull every job on the next day's schedule and verify each one is complete and correct: address, scope of work, roofline count and details, color and product selections, special requests, gate codes, pets, parking and ladder access, power outlet locations, and any note the customer added since booking.
* Confirm the crew assignment on every job and that the assigned crew can see it.
* Confirm materials and equipment for each job are accounted for so nothing gets discovered at 7:00 AM.
* Flag anything incomplete or contradictory to the install lead **tonight**, not tomorrow.

**Today's billing.**

* Collect balances due on every job completed today. Run the card on file, send the payment link, make the call — whatever it takes to close it out the same day.
* Verify deposits collected on jobs booked today.
* Reconcile the day: what was invoiced, what was collected, what's outstanding and why.
* Escalate anything you can't collect with the reason, same day.

**Today's time cards.**

* Confirm every crew member is punched out. Chase down anyone who forgot before you close the day and get their timecard corrected.
* Review the day's hours against the job schedule and flag anything that doesn't reconcile.
* **Corrections follow the documented process, every time:** note what was changed, why, and get the crew member's confirmation. We do not adjust anyone's recorded hours silently. Our payroll is tied to hours and to installed revenue, and Arizona requires us to keep accurate daily records for four years. This is the single most compliance\-sensitive task in the role, and we will train you on it specifically.

**Set the crews up.**

* Send the end\-of\-day rundown: tomorrow's jobs, crew assignments, anything unusual, anything that changed.
* Communicate any late reschedule, cancellation, or add to the crews affected.
* Note anything the morning shift needs to pick up.

4\. Daily Handoff

* Start of shift: read the opening receptionist's handoff and pick up anything open.
* End of shift: send a short close\-out\- calls answered, voicemails returned, quotes sent, leads booked, billing collected and outstanding, time card exceptions, tomorrow's board confirmed clean, and anything needing leadership's decision.

Qualifications

**Required**

* 2\+ years in reception, scheduling, dispatch, inside sales, or admin support\- ideally somewhere with a real phone volume.
* **Located in the United States.** This role must be W\-2, and we need US employment eligibility.
* Clear, warm phone presence. You'll be the voice of the company for the entire evening.
* Strong written communication\- a large share of customer contact is text and email.
* Genuinely organized, and specifically the kind of organized t

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Quality, Safety & Regulatory
new_jobs.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.  



Day \- 08 Hour (United States of America)
**This is a Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley job.**  

  

**A Brief Overview**  

The Quality, Safety \& Regulatory Program Manager supports the Interventional and Procedural Services Platform by coordinating quality metrics, safety event follow\-up, regulatory readiness, infection prevention partnership, radiation/contrast/sedation safety tracking, high\-level disinfection oversight coordination, and procedural safety standards.
  

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of Quality and PI, the Program Manager works closely with the VP of Interventional Services, Senior Director of Procedural Nursing and Clinical Operations, Platform Medical Director, specialty medical directors, managers, Quality, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, Regulatory, Radiation Safety, Pharmacy, and other partners to ensure the platform has reliable quality infrastructure and visible accountability for improvement.
  

  

This role is intended to be a central integration point for procedural quality, safety, and regulatory work. The Coordinator does not replace department\-level accountability; rather, the role creates standard processes, dashboards, follow\-up discipline, and escalation pathways across OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post, and related procedural services.
  

  

**Locations**  

Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley
  

  

**What you will do**

Quality Dashboard and Performance Monitoring


* Develop, maintain, and coordinate platform quality and safety dashboards for OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post/PACU/Procedural Recovery, and related procedural services.
* Track procedural quality indicators, infection prevention indicators, procedural complications, sedation events, radiation dose outliers, contrast events, unplanned transfers/admissions, retained item risks, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization biological indicator failures, and other agreed measures.
* Prepare routine reports for the Monthly Procedural Quality and Safety Committee, Interventional Services Executive Council, and leadership review.

Safety Event Review and Corrective Action Coordination


* Coordinate review, classification, follow\-up, and closure tracking for procedural safety events, near misses, regulatory findings, and improvement actions.
* Support root cause analysis, apparent cause analysis, action planning, audit design, and evidence collection in collaboration with Quality and Patient Safety partners.
* Ensure action plans have owners, timelines, evidence of completion, and sustainment measures.

Regulatory Readiness and Survey Support


* Coordinate procedural regulatory readiness activities, mock survey preparation, tracers, documentation audits, policy review, competency tracking evidence, and survey response support.
* Maintain readiness focus for surgical/procedural safety standards, sedation safety, high\-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation safety, contrast safety, medication safety, specimen handling, and SPD/sterilization processes.
* Partner with managers to identify gaps, escalate risks, and support timely corrective action.

Cross\-Functional Improvement and Standardization


* Support standardization of policies, procedures, checklists, audits, dashboards, and escalation pathways across procedural areas.
* Facilitate interdisciplinary improvement workgroups as assigned, including sedation safety, procedural verification, high\-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation/contrast safety, and SPD/OR reliability.
* Promote a Just Culture, high\-reliability principles, C\-I\-CARE, and transparent learning from events.

Key Performance Metrics


* Timeliness and completeness of quality dashboards, monthly reporting, action item closure, and sustainment audits.
* Safety event follow\-up completion, corrective action verification, regulatory readiness scores, audit completion, and survey finding closure.
* Performance trends in sedation safety, radiation/contrast safety, infection prevention, retained item risk, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization monitoring, and procedural complications.
* Manager and physician leader satisfaction with quality reporting, escalation visibility, and improvement support.

Employee must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the C\-I\-CARE Standards of the Hospital. C\-I\-CARE is the foundation of Stanford Health Care Tri\-Valley’s patient experience and represents a framework for patient\-centered interactions.  



  

**Education Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, public health, clinical discipline, or related field required. Master’s degree preferred.

  

**Experience Qualifications**

* Minimum of four (4\) years of healthcare experience in quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, perioperative/procedural services, infection prevention, nursing, or clinical operations.
* Experience with quality dashboards, safety event analysis, regulatory surveys, infection prevention, high\-level disinfection, sedation safety, radiation or contrast safety, or procedural environments preferred.

  

**License/Certification**

* Clinical license preferred when applicable to candidate background. CPHQ, CPPS, CIC, or related quality/safety/regulatory certification preferred.

  

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* Knowledge of healthcare quality, patient safety, regulatory standards, performance improvement, audit methods, and event follow\-up.
* Ability to work independently, organize complex cross\-functional work, and influence without direct authority.
* Strong data management, dashboard coordination,

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**  

AbbVie Clinical Data Strategy and Operations is the best\-in\-class team within its cross\-industry peer group and is responsible for bringing people, process, and technology together to generate business value from clinical trials data. Our operational model is exemplified through execution and innovation. This role is key to ensuring successful delivery against the program\- and study\-level accountabilities assigned to Clinical Data Strategy and Operations (CDSO).


Responsibilities

* Aligns CDSO study teams with program\- and study\-level strategies. For assigned studies, leads the CDSO Study Team and represents DS as a member of the cross\-functional study team
* For assigned studies, acts as single point of contact and accountable operational lead from DSS. Coordinates associated DSS study teams to meet operational objectives. Engages and connects global functional and cross\-functional teams
* Interacts with and influences cross\-functional team members to achieve program and study objectives
* Utilizes operational analytics and project management tools to optimize execution of programs and studies, to manage internal and external resources, to track study progress, and to prepare study status reports. Anticipates and identifies issues that could affect timelines or quality and develops options and solutions
* Ensures adherence to federal regulations and applicable local regulations, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), ICH Guidelines, AbbVie Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and to functional quality standards. Stays abreast of new and/or evolving local regulations, guidelines and policies related to clinical development
* Participates in oversight of vendors and provides feedback related to study operations, issues, and trends in performance
* Responsible for coaching and mentoring Data Science Associates. May include indirect supervision of work for contract resources
* Participates in CDSO and cross\-functional innovation and process improvement initiatives
* Contributes to study execution “lessons learned” across functions

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, management information systems, computer science, life sciences or equivalent. Master’s preferred. PMP Certification or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt desired
* Must have at 3\+ years of pharma / clinical research / data management / health care experience or 5\+ years of project management experience (and / or applicable work experience)
* Strong understanding of clinical trial process and clinical technology. Experience in managing a clinical trial from initiation through to completion is preferred
* Demonstrated effective leadership skills
* Demonstrated ability to influence others without direct authority
* Demonstrated effective communication skills
* Demonstrated effective analytical skills

Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future.
* We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
* This job is eligible to participate in our short\-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.
